mutations.name: first_version_wins
first_evidence_wins
mutations.before:
pure def matchingEvidence(env: Environment, premise: Premise): List[EvidenceDecision] =
    env.evidence.select(decision => decision.premise.request.entryId == premise.request.entryId)

mutations.name: promote_disputed_evidence
mutations.after: | Disputed => { conclusion: knownOf(premise.questionId, record), issues: List(), provenance: provenance }

mutations.name: promote_unauthenticated_evidence
mutations.after: | Unauthenticated => { conclusion: knownOf(premise.questionId, record), issues: List(), provenance: provenance }

mutations.name: promote_missing_evidence
mutations.after: | EvidenceMissing => { conclusion: knownOf(premise.questionId, record), issues: List(), provenance: provenance }

mutations.name: missing_as_permission
mutations.after: | NoRuling => { conclusion: KnownConclusionValue({ questionId: premise.questionId, question: record.question, answer: J::TaklifiAnswer(Set(J::Mubah)), scope: record.scope }), issues: List(), provenance: provenance }

mutations.name: suspension_as_permission
mutations.after: | Suspended => { conclusion: KnownConclusionValue({ questionId: premise.questionId, question: record.question, answer: J::TaklifiAnswer(Set(J::Mubah)), scope: record.scope }), issues: List(), provenance: provenance }

mutations.name: promote_registry_candidate
discard_required_blocker
mutations.after: else if (issues.length() > 0) { conclusion: left.conclusion, issues: List(), provenance: provenance }

mutations.name: overwrite_question_identity
mutations.before: questionId: premise.questionId, question: record.question, answer: answer, scope: record.scope
mutations.after: questionId: 1, question: record.question, answer: answer, scope: record.scope

mutations.name: conflict_selects_left_interpretation
mutations.after: | AnswerConflict => { conclusion: KnownConclusionValue(a), issues: List(), provenance: provenance }
